definition.label: Master Intensity
definition.description: Brightness of architectural emission and its local material response.

definition.label: Music Reactivity
definition.description: Scales all music-driven light, geometry, spark, atmosphere and drop behavior.

definition.label: Auto Performance
definition.description: Lets shared Audio Intelligence select the vault reveal and rupture behavior while retaining the selected Light Program as the resting look.

definition.label: BPM Sync
definition.description: Locks aisle travel to the detected musical clock; without a track the camera continues at the authored pace.

definition.label: Camera Motion
definition.description: Full uses the authored aisle flight, Reduced slows it, and Lock Off holds the opening view.

definition.label: Active Architecture
definition.description: How much of the aisle participates in the selected light program.

definition.label: Arch Expansion
definition.description: Base outward separation of the arch structure before musical modulation.

definition.label: Light Program
definition.description: Chooses how cyan and gold light travels through the arch groups. A manual choice turns Auto Performance off.

definition.label: Pattern Change
definition.description: When enabled, each qualified Trigger advances through a deterministic shuffled cycle with no immediate repeat.

definition.label: Spark Density
definition.description: Maximum deterministic spark population available to snare and drop accents.

definition.label: Atmosphere
definition.description: Depth-aware haze that separates the repeating architecture.

definition.label: Light Shafts
definition.description: Strength of cyan and gold volumetric light through the aisle.

definition.label: Floor Reflection
definition.description: Strength of the dark wet-floor reflection beneath the arches.

definition.label: Bloom
definition.description: Contained HDR halo around illuminated ribs and sparks.

definition.label: Cinematic Finish
definition.description: Filmic tone, contrast, vignette and restrained grain.

definition.label: Background
definition.description: Color of the deep space beyond the architecture.

definition.label: Structure
definition.description: Base material color of columns, arches, ribs and floor rails.

definition.label: Primary Light
definition.description: Main architectural light color; cyan by default.

definition.label: Accent Light
definition.description: Secondary apex, column and spark color; gold by default.
